title: Celery Potato Soup
description: A delicious combination of russet potatoes, celery, and onion, this easy soup will warm you from the inside out.
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, minced, or more to taste
2 large russet potatoes, cut into 1-inch pieces
0.5 tablespoon garlic salt, or more to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a stockpot over medium-high heat; stir in onion. Cook and stir until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add potatoes and celery and saute until celery is tender and slightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Add water, bouillon cube, garlic salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
Fill blender halfway with soup. Cover and hold lid down with a potholder; pulse a few times before leaving on to blend. Pour into a pot. Repeat with remaining soup. Serve hot.
